components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary Electric Violet operational action button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8B5CF6; color: #F5F5F0; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #7C3AED; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -10px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.72); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B5CF6; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Form Input
components.description: Recessed Midnight Black text field with Electric Violet focus ring.

narrative.overview: GARMENTFLOW translates DP ENTERPRISES's daily garment manufacturing operations—bulk stitching contracts, fabric yardage, worker attendance, and profit/loss reconciliation—into an industrial-grade glassmorphic operations cockpit. Rather than borrowing generic pastel SaaS themes, it commits strictly to a five-color material system anchored by Midnight Black and Pearl White grounds, Carbon Black frosted panels, Electric Violet active highlights, and Rosso Corsa critical alerts.
keyCharacteristics: Strict five-color brand discipline across Dark and Light modes
Frosted glassmorphism containers with crisp hairline borders
Tabular numeric alignment for INR (₹) valuations, quantities, and working hours
Organic View-Transition ink-spread theme switching with reduced-motion fallback

rules.name: The Five-Color Discipline Rule
rules.body: Never introduce unanchored accent colors; operational highlights belong exclusively to Electric Violet (#8B5CF6), critical/loss states to Rosso Corsa (#D50000), and positive financial confirmation to restrained semantic green (#22C55E).

dos: Do enforce tabular-nums on every currency figure, piece count, working-hour readout, and order ID.
Do preserve high text contrast (>= 4.5:1) across all seven background presets in both Dark and Light modes.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion on both KPI count-ups and the ink-spread theme transition.
donts: Don't introduce unrelated decorative accent colors outside the five-color system.
Don't add payment gateways, customer checkout flows, or e-commerce tropes.
Don't double-count stock consumption or worker salary ledgers on top of order-level material/labour costs in Profit & Loss.
